### Private Worship - Truth For Life - July 15
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-15-2021.html
Passage: Leviticus 6:13
Points:
- The altar of private prayer must be kept continually burning, as secret communion sustains all authentic spiritual life.
- Believers should cultivate consistent, frequent, and undistracted times alone with God to intercede for others.
- Lukewarmness in personal devotion is a warning sign of spiritual decline that requires repentance and renewed seeking of grace.
- Neglecting private devotion allows worldly conformity to creep in, dampening faith in the family and the church.
- Scripture and personal time in the presence of Jesus serve as coals and fuel to keep the heart aflame with love for God.
